transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

I decided to come in because I don't feel safe anymore. There is a specific group of people—I think it's some kind of organization—that has been following me and monitoring my every move. I just need help making them stop.
Besides feeling watched, have you experienced any significant periods where your mood was extremely high or low, or where you had a major change in your energy levels or sleep patterns?

No, my mood and energy levels have been relatively normal, and I haven't had any extreme highs or lows. My sleep is okay too, though I do get quite stressed and anxious because of the people watching me. Aside from that constant stress, everything else feels fine.
Other than the belief that you are being watched, have you ever heard voices, seen things, or felt sensations that others around you did not seem to notice?

No, I have never heard voices or seen things that aren't there, and I haven't felt any strange physical sensations either. My senses are completely normal. The only issue is the very real tracking and monitoring by that group of people.
